title: Fast Rates for Offline Q-Learning with KL Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2610.18839v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper investigates offline Q-learning for finite-horizon Markov decision processes with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization. Recent studies have shown that KL regularization can yield fast rates in offline decision-making problems. However, it remains unclear whether Q-learning, which adopts incremental stochastic approximation updates, can achieve such fast rates in the offline setting. We first propose KL-regularized Q-Learning (KLQ), a simple variant of classical Q-learning. By exploiting KL regularization, we prove that KLQ achieves a sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}(1/\epsilon)$ without explicit pessimism. This guarantee, however, has an exponential dependence on the KL regularization parameter and the horizon. translated_title: 带KL正则化的离线Q学习的快速收敛率
translated_abstract: 本文研究了具有Kullback-Leibler（KL）正则化的有限时域马尔可夫决策过程中的离线Q学习问题。最近的研究表明，KL正则化可以在离线决策问题中带来快速收敛率。然而，采用增量式随机近似更新的Q学习能否在离线设置中实现这样的快速收敛率仍不清楚。我们首先提出了KL正则化Q学习（KLQ），这是经典Q学习的一个简单变体。通过利用KL正则化，我们证明了KLQ在无需显式悲观主义的情况下达到了$\widetilde{O}(1/\epsilon)$的样本复杂度。然而，这一保证对KL正则化参数和时域长度存在指数级依赖。为了解决这一局限，我们进一步提出了KL正则化悲观Q学习（KLPQ），它将悲观主义引入KLQ中。我们证明了KLPQ在保持相同的$\widetilde{O}(1/\epsilon)$收敛率的同时，消除了这一指数依赖。
tldr: 本文提出了KL正则化Q学习（KLQ）及其悲观版本KLPQ，首次证明采用增量式随机近似更新的Q学习在离线设置下无需显式悲观即可达到$\widetilde{O}(1/\epsilon)$的快速样本复杂度，且KLPQ进一步消除了对KL正则化参数和时域长度的指数依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KL-regularized Q-Learning (KLQ) and its pessimistic variant KLPQ, establishing for the first time that Q-learning with incremental stochastic approximation updates can achieve a fast $\widetilde{O}(1/\epsilon)$ sample complexity in offline settings without explicit pessimism, with KLPQ further removing the exponential dependence on the KL regularization parameter and the horizon.
